# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Image comparison and rendering fixes**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.159.0 adds experimental image comparison tools and corrects runtime-effect uniforms and texture-edge sampling. The unreleased line introduces a separate SkiaSharp.Testing package for visual assertions and difference diagnostics. It also changes Tizen's CPU blur selection and drops Linux x86 native assets.

## Breaking Changes

- **Move Linux x86 applications to a supported architecture** — Linux x86 native assets are no longer built or included in NuGet packages. Applications targeting 32-bit Linux must move to a supported Linux architecture before upgrading. ([#5784](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5784))

## API Surface

- **Experimental visual assertions** — The separate SkiaSharp.Testing package adds SKImageComparison for images, bitmaps and pixmaps, with channel tolerances, masks, mismatch budgets, error metrics and five difference-image styles. Opt in to the experimental API by suppressing SKIA4001 with NoWarn or a pragma. Results retain no native handles; dispose returned difference images yourself. ([#5293](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5293))

## Bug Fixes

- **Uniform buffers start cleared** — New SKRuntimeEffectUniforms buffers now contain zeros rather than uninitialized memory. Reset clears the existing buffer in place, restoring the documented zero state without allocating a replacement native buffer or wrapper. Tests cover both runtime effects and meshes. — ❤️ [@taublast](https://github.com/taublast) ([#5843](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5843))
- **Filtered texture samples stay inside subsets** — Ganesh uses inward texture-subset clamping to avoid sampling undefined exterior texels at filtered edges, and avoids direct linear copies at affected logical texture edges. Texture-edge pixels may change; CPU and Graphite rendering are unaffected. ([#5679](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5679))
- **Tizen CPU blur selection takes effect** — Tizen now applies its blur-path setting when compiling Skia, selecting the existing ThreeBoxApprox/Tent paths instead of the shader-based Gaussian candidate. Blur pixels and performance may differ; Tizen rendering and performance were not measured in the supporting change. ([#5679](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5679))
